description: This Java class 'JunitSuiteWrapper' is used to load and manage JUnit test suites based on XML configurations within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to retrieve test suites and test cases for execution.

classes.name: JunitSuiteWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class to load, manage, and retrieve JUnit test suites based on XML configurations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: JunitSuiteWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test suite list by loading test suite configurations for a given component, suite, and test case.

methods.name: populateTestSuite
methods.description: Deprecated method to add all loaded test cases into a given TestSuite object.

methods.name: getModelTestSuites
methods.description: Returns the list of loaded ModelTestSuite objects.

methods.name: getAllTestList
methods.description: Returns a list of all Test objects from the loaded test suites.
